comments.body: The vendoring override only checks `GOFLAGS`, not the command-line build arguments. For a vendored project invoked as `otelc go build -mod=vendor ./...`, this appends `GOFLAGS=-mod=mod`, but the explicit `-mod=vendor` argument takes precedence and Go still performs the stale `vendor/modules.txt` consistency check after setup edits `go.mod`, so the build fails. Detect the `-mod` setting from the parsed build arguments as well (or otherwise handle explicit `-mod=vendor`) before applying this fallback.
